plan_title: Monitoring, Reporting, and Verification Plan, Rose Carbon Capture and Storage Facility, Jefferson County, Texas
ama_definition: The AMA is treated as functionally equivalent to the MMA: the modeled free-phase plume at 39 years after start of injection (plume stabilization) plus a half-mile buffer, held constant for the life of the project (p22-23).
mma_definition: The stabilized free-phase CO2 plume, simulated to reach maximum extent 39 years after start of injection (26 years post-injection), plus an all-around half-mile buffer (p22).
leakage_pathways_rated_significant: None rated more than low likelihood. The plan screens six pathways (injection/monitor well integrity, legacy wells, monitoring equipment failure, UCCZ integrity including one mapped fault, induced/natural seismicity, surface equipment) and calls each low or negligible; wells and surface equipment get the most monitoring attention (p27-31).
baseline_summary: A pre-injection baseline program: groundwater/geochemical samples from the above-zone well and three USDW wells, downhole pressure/temperature before injection, a baseline (reprocessed) seismic survey, pre-operational surface equipment inspection, baseline soil gas and air samples, and a seismometer array recording since 1 July 2024 (p30, p39). Operating data are also compared to baseline and predicted values (p32).
reporting_summary: Annual Subpart RR report per 40 CFR 98.442 with the mass balance; any surface leakage mass and estimation method documented in that report (p41, p43). Seismic events M2+ within 5.6 miles of an injector are reported to the UIC Program Director; monitoring frequency changes need Director approval (p31, p33). No commitment to publish measurement data.

rows.detail: Two Coriolis mass flow meters on two flowlines at the central pad measure rate, density and total mass; gas chromatograph at the pad; injection stream sampled quarterly and sent to a lab.
rows.location: Central pad (custody transfer point from the single CO2 pipeline)
rows.evidence_quote: Two Coriolis flow meters, installed at the central pad, will be used to directly measure the mass flow rate of the injected fluid.

rows.detail: Wellhead tubing pressure, downhole pressure/temperature, rate and CO2 stream temperature recorded continuously (5-second sampling, 5-minute recording) on a SCADA system watched by an Operations Control Center, with alarms.
rows.location: Each injection wellhead and downhole gauge; central pad; distribution piping
rows.trigger_or_response: Pressure outside tolerances (about 90% of fracture gradient or permitted wellhead pressure) alarms; anomalies investigated against baseline and predicted values; automatic shut-off devices.
rows.evidence_quote: Alarms will be set for pressures outside described tolerances (generally 90% of fracture gradient and prescribed wellhead pressures)

rows.detail: Continuous wellhead gauge on the tubing/long-string annulus plus a level transmitter on the annulus fluid tank; fluid additions or removals documented; alarms on annular pressure or fluid changes.
rows.location: Each injection wellhead and annulus system tank
rows.trigger_or_response: Annular pressure anomaly: field personnel examine; minor repairs done promptly, otherwise well shut in; emissions estimated and reported.
rows.evidence_quote: the pressure on the annulus between the tubing and the long-string casing

rows.detail: Annual annulus pressure test; pressure falloff tests at the end of each injection stage (also described as annual during shut-ins); baseline casing inspection log with repeats only if triggered.
rows.trigger_or_response: Deficiency in falloff or annulus test indicates loss of integrity; casing log repeated if leakage risk apparent or UIC Director requests.
rows.evidence_quote: Deficiency identified during pressure falloff tests and annulus pressure tests.

rows.detail: Downhole pressure/temperature gauges in each injector's open interval and a tubing-encapsulated cable with in-line gauges across four intervals in In-Zone Monitoring Well No. 01, used to track the pressure front and calibrate the model.
rows.location: Three injection wells and In-Zone Monitoring Well No. 01 (Bead Farm Company #4)
rows.trigger_or_response: Pressure front tracking indicating potential impact to legacy wells or above UCCZ prompts investigation, model updates and phased corrective action.
rows.evidence_quote: Collect pressure and temperature measurements for evaluating the rate of CO2 plume and pressure front movement

rows.detail: Routine visual inspections and preventive maintenance of wellheads, flowlines and other surface components; equipment inspected, tested and calibrated before commissioning.
rows.location: Surface facilities between central pad and wellheads
rows.trigger_or_response: Problems found during inspection: minor repairs made promptly, otherwise well shut in; CO2 emissions estimated and reported.
rows.evidence_quote: Routine visual inspections and preventative maintenance of all surface components.

rows.detail: Stationary CO2 detectors named as one option for contingent air monitoring; no fixed sensors described as routine monitoring (see atmospheric_co2 row).
rows.trigger_or_response: Only deployed after a confirmed release to the USDW.
rows.evidence_quote: Portable and/or stationary CO2 detectors monitor record ambient CO2 concentrations

rows.detail: Soil gas samples from the unsaturated zone, only as a response to a confirmed release to the USDW; baseline soil gas samples already collected.
rows.trigger_or_response: Confirmed release to USDW triggers soil gas sampling.
rows.evidence_quote: Soil gas and air monitoring are proposed only as responses to triggering events. However, baseline samples of each have been collected.

rows.detail: Quarterly fluid sampling from three USDW monitoring wells in the upper Chicot Aquifer (about 300-350 ft), pre-operational and operational phases, analyzed for water quality and geochemical trends; baseline collected.
rows.location: USDW Monitoring Wells No. 1, 2R and 3 within the AoR
rows.trigger_or_response: Statistically significant change versus baseline indicates possible leak; additional USDW wells added if plume/pressure tracking warrants.
rows.evidence_quote: Sample fluids from the Chicot Aquifer which is the most prolific USDW aquifer within the MMA

rows.detail: Quarterly fluid samples collected through tubing from the first laterally continuous water-bearing zone above the UCCZ in converted stratigraphic well Bead Farm Co. #1, supplemented by time-lapse seismic; baseline samples collected.
rows.location: Above-Zone Monitoring Well No. 01 (Bead Farm Co. #1) on the central pad
rows.trigger_or_response: Statistically significant change in fluid chemistry indicates CO2 or brine crossflow; corrective action plan updated.
rows.evidence_quote: fluid sampling from the first laterally continuous zone above the UCCZ, supplemented by time-lapse seismic surveys

rows.detail: Annual distributed temperature sensing on cemented fiber to detect flow through cement channels; one-time DTS cement evaluation; baseline through-tubing casing inspection log with repeats only if triggered.
rows.trigger_or_response: Casing log repeated if leakage risk apparent or UIC Director requests; legacy well re-entry for casing/cement logs if a well is suspected.
rows.evidence_quote: DTS to assess potential flow through channels through or along cement

rows.detail: Permanent on-site near-surface seismometer array with continuous sampling and near-real-time processing, operated by a third party, recording since 1 July 2024; also USGS notifications and public data.
rows.location: Selected surface locations within the AoR; USGS network
rows.trigger_or_response: Event of M2 or larger within 5.6 miles of an injector: notify UIC Program Director, jointly assess link to operations, implement seismic response actions.
rows.evidence_quote: ExxonMobil has installed a permanent seismicity monitoring system on-site, which is being monitored by a third party

rows.detail: Time-lapse surface seismic over the plume area: baseline from reprocessed 2024/2025 data, repeat surveys within 1-3 years, 6-8 years and at year 13 (end of injection), plus contingent PISC surveys.
rows.location: CO2 plume area, surface to base of Frio Sand 2
rows.trigger_or_response: Unexpected lateral or vertical plume migration above the UCCZ prompts update of the corrective action plan; additional surveys subject to UIC Director approval.
rows.evidence_quote: Indirect method to monitor CO2 plume growth in the subsurface over time

rows.detail: Portable and/or stationary CO2 detectors recording ambient CO2 concentrations, deployed only after a confirmed release to the USDW; baseline air samples collected.
rows.trigger_or_response: Confirmed release to USDW triggers air monitoring.
rows.evidence_quote: Portable and/or stationary CO2 detectors monitor record ambient CO2 concentrations

rows.detail: Corrosion coupons of project metals checked quarterly under 40 CFR 146.90(c).
rows.evidence_quote: Measure corrosion levels on the types of metal used in the Project

rows.detail: Reservoir model forecast updates and AoR/MMA/AMA reevaluation using monitoring data at least every five years, used to time monitoring and phased corrective action on legacy wells.
rows.trigger_or_response: Observed plume or pressure front differing from prediction may trigger more frequent review, corrective action and MRV plan revision.
rows.evidence_quote: reevaluate the AoR (including free phase CO2 plume), MMA, and AMA based on site-specific monitoring data at the minimum frequency of 5 years

rows.detail: Equipment leaks and vented emissions between the injection meters and wellheads quantified with Subpart W methods for the mass balance.
rows.location: Surface equipment between central pad meters and wellheads
rows.evidence_quote: will be measured and reported in accordance with the requirements of 40 CFR 98.444(d)/Subpart W.

rows.detail: One-time aeromagnetic survey (September 2023) over the predicted plume to find undocumented wells; characterization, not ongoing monitoring.
rows.evidence_quote: an aeromagnetic survey was conducted on September 2023 to assess the predicted CO2 plume boundary for undocumented artificial penetrations

notes: Pages 11 and 25 (Figures 3-1 and 4-1, the well/AoR map and the AMA/MMA map) are image-only. Table 3-1 lists four 'Shallow Groundwater Wells' (20-25 ft deep) in addition to the three USDW monitoring wells, but the monitoring program (Tables 6-2/6-3, Section 7) only describes sampling the three USDW wells; the shallow wells' role is not stated. Falloff test frequency is given inconsistently ('at the end of every injection stage' in Table 6-2 vs 'annual' in Table 6-3). Table 6-3 flags the passive seismic array as 'Phased/Triggered: Yes, contingent on triggering seismic events' while listing continuous monitoring; coded as committed because the array is installed and recording. 'Air monitoring' with portable or stationary detectors is coded under atmospheric_co2 (conditional); fixed_gas_detectors is mentioned_only for the stationary option. Visual inspection baseline marked 'unclear' because the plan lists a pre-operational equipment inspection as a baseline element but it is not a measurement compared against later readings. Reporting section (Section 11) is a single sentence. Implementation date proposed as October 1, 2025 although the plan is dated November 2025. Reservoir model updates and reductions in indirect monitoring frequency require UIC Program Director approval.
